title: Evvy
description: Provides a suite of administrative commands and optimization tools designed for managing server-wide live events.
body:
# 🛠️ EvvyMod - Administrative & Event Suite

EvvyMod is a powerful server utility designed for administrators to manage, optimize, and control server-wide live events seamlessly.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Custom Creative Tab:** Features a dedicated medieval-style tab labeled "EvvyMod - LupinStudios" for quick access to all administrative tools.
* **The Ban Stick:** A specialized tool designed for immediate moderation actions during high-stakes live events.
* **Linker Hammer & Teleportation Pads:** Easily link TP Block 1 (Blue) and TP Block 2 (Orange/Red) by right-clicking them with the Linker Hammer to create instant, reliable transit networks.
* **Full Localization:** Complete built-in support for both English (`en_us`) and Italian (`it_it`) with descriptive tooltips and technical chat confirmations.

## ⚙️ Environment Configuration
This mod is optimized for **Forge 1.20.1** and functions perfectly in both client and server environments.
